'''Torani Kulda''' of the [[Virulli Clan]] was a [[Gender|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who operated during the years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

[[File:Torani_Kulda_mini_game.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kulda's fighter]]
Small and lithe, even for a Rodian, Kulda exuded calm confidence and open disdain for anyone she considered to be beneath her notice. She possessed light green skin and golden eyes. A prominent trio of scars, which she made no attempt to conceal, crossed her brow. She was considered a devious foe and often worked in tandem with her partner, the Rodian [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[A0-2]], to overcome their foes. She flew a [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]].
